gaps.description: The README documents the Windows cache folder as %LOCALAPPDATA%\linkwatch\linkwatch\Cache. platformdirs may resolve this differently, and the trial only ran on Linux, so the documented path is unverified.

concerns: test_cache_round_trip sets LINKWATCH_CACHE_DIR, so the real platform path is never exercised.

suggested_tests.name: test_default_cache_dir_matches_readme
suggested_tests.purpose: Unset LINKWATCH_CACHE_DIR and compare cache_dir() with the documented path per platform
